name: Wafer-edge inspection system family
aliases: 晶圆边缘全维度检测设备

evidence.excerpt: 公司积极配合一线国际客户的新需求，在晶圆边缘检测系统中开发明暗场结合激光光学技术，针对晶圆 键合工艺中 thinning、trimming、bonding、coating 制程段增加了晶圆修边幅度、加工尺寸检测、晶圆 bonding 对准检测、粘合物工艺监测、EBR 监测以及 bonding 过程中出现的气泡、碎片、剥落、聚合物残留等新的缺陷检 测功能，完善了对 HBM、TSV 制程工艺的不良监控，获得了客户的充分认可并成功获得批量设备订单，为公司半导 体板块的持续增长增加了新的动力源泉。

notes: Group-level supplier claim; original does not attribute this system specifically to Optima or Chinese production. Batch orders are unquantified and linked to HBM/TSV process monitoring, not all semiconductor revenue. FY2023 p11 explicitly describes edge-system trim-width/dimensional measurement, bonding alignment inspection, bonding-process and EBR monitoring, and bubble/fragments/peeling/polymer-residue defect functions. These are functions of this existing edge family, not separate overlay tools or proof of acoustic/X-ray subsurface inspection.

maturity_history.excerpt: 完善了对 HBM、TSV 制程工艺的不良监控，获得了客户的充分认可并成功获得批量设备订单
maturity_history.notes: Supplier claim. The order is not quantified; no shipment, acceptance, production-use or revenue amount is stated. Do not apply this stage to every Secote semiconductor tool. Report-period/disclosure context, not a separately established exact event date; supplier assertion remains uncorroborated independently.

maturity_history.excerpt: 出货至国内头部FAB厂的晶圆边缘全维度检测设备现已获客户验收通过
maturity_history.notes: A tool or equipment scope was shipped and accepted; grammatical wording does not provide a reliable physical unit count. No HBM linkage is made in this specific sentence.
